name: Deck-style navigation through 3D worlds
description: Arrow keys, Space, Enter and clicks step through animations; up and down skip scenes; each scene is its own lit 3D world reached by a camera flight.
prompt_snippet: Make it move like a slide deck: right arrow, Space, Enter and left click step through animations, left arrow and right click step back, up and down skip whole scenes, Home and End jump to the ends. Each scene is its own lit 3D world, reached by a 1.9 second eased camera flight with a slight arc.

name: Glass HUD with two-clause headline
description: Left HUD with numbered eyebrow, a statement headline plus a gradient outcome clause, a lead, and beats marked done, now and later.
prompt_snippet: Show a glass HUD on the left: a numbered eyebrow ("03 · The method"), a two-clause headline whose second clause uses a light-blue to blue to green gradient, a one-sentence lead, and a beats list where the current click glows and earlier ones dim.

name: Hero open and close
description: Centered bottom headline over rising Cisco bridge bars for the opening and the close.
prompt_snippet: Open and close on a hero layout: the Cisco bridge bars rise from a reflective grid with orbiting rings, and a wide headline sits centered at the bottom over a scrim.

name: Focus card for a numbered structure
description: One large card per step with block number, colored heading, quoted fragment in mono and an explanation; tiles orbit a core.
prompt_snippet: Teach the structure with a focus layout: one large card per click with the block number, a heading in the block color, a quoted fragment in monospace and a one-line explanation, while colored tiles orbit a core and the current one pulls forward.

name: New sky on every scene
description: Sky shader blending aurora, horizon grid, data rain and starfield; palette changes per scene and turns with the story.
prompt_snippet: Change the sky on every scene with a shader that blends aurora curtains, a horizon grid, data rain and a starfield. Turn it with the story: red or amber during the problem, blue or green after the fix. Adjacent scenes never share a palette.

name: Morphing particle field
description: One 7,000-point additive field that morphs into a new formation per scene (runways, halo, city, map plane, helix, hexes).
prompt_snippet: Add one shared field of about 7,000 additive particles that morphs over two seconds into a formation that fits each scene, such as runways under an airport, a halo over a hospital, a city of departments or a helix for a method.

name: A diorama for every idea
description: Each scene shows its message as an object or system that changes on every click.
prompt_snippet: Give every scene a 3D diorama that shows its idea as an object or system, and make every click change something visible in it: light a tier, pull a block forward, swap a screen, fold or flip the object.

name: Crisp labels after bloom
description: Labels, panels and screenshots render on an overlay layer after the bloom pass.
prompt_snippet: Render labels, canvas panels and screenshots on a separate overlay layer after the bloom pass, without fog or tone mapping, so text stays sharp in a glowing scene.

name: World and screen with live links
description: A diorama of a customer's world beside a glass browser screen stepping through captures, with live link buttons.
prompt_snippet: For each example, build a diorama of its real world beside a glass browser screen (traffic lights, URL bar) that steps through 1280x720 captures and an optional short muted clip, with a live link button in the corner.

name: Lineage galaxy
description: Builds as glowing nodes on a spiral, connected by arcs in creation order.
prompt_snippet: Show a sequence of builds as glowing nodes on a spiral galaxy, joined by arcs in the order they were made, lighting one generation per click.

name: Pyramid flip
description: An inverted pyramid balanced on its point flips onto a solid base and lights tier by tier.
prompt_snippet: Use a pyramid flip for the structural insight: an inverted pyramid wobbles on its point, flips onto a solid base, then lights tier by tier from the base up.

name: Live workshop builder
description: Audience fills a brief, 3D base slabs light as they type, a 10 minute timer runs, one-click copy.
prompt_snippet: Include a live workshop scene: a glass form grouped by block color where the audience fills a short brief, 3D base slabs that light as fields fill, a 10 minute timer shown in 3D and on a button, and a Copy prompt button.

name: Presenter camera box
description: Bottom-right 4:3 webcam box with name tag; C toggles the webcam, B hides it.
prompt_snippet: Add a presenter camera box bottom right (4:3, thin blue border, soft glow, name tag) that shows the webcam when C is pressed and hides with B.

name: Presenter window
description: Second window with big bullets, the full note, next-click preview and a clock, synced both ways.
prompt_snippet: Add a presenter window (P) that syncs with the stage both ways over a BroadcastChannel and shows large bullets for the current click, the full note, a preview of the next click and an elapsed clock.

name: Talking points window with pace clock
description: Off-camera window with big bullets and an on pace, ahead or behind clock at 150 words per minute.
prompt_snippet: Add an off-camera talking points window (T) with big bullets for the current and next click, a clickable scene outline, and a pace clock at 150 words per minute that reads on pace, ahead or behind.

name: Printable talk track and notes drawer
description: Notes drawer on stage and a printable talk track with sources and links.
prompt_snippet: Write spoken notes for every click, show them in a notes drawer (N), and offer a printable talk track with every note, live link and source.

name: Narrated film edition
description: Second edition that plays by itself with pre-rendered neural voices, a start gate, captions with word highlighting, a scrubber and chapter menu.
prompt_snippet: Build a narrated film edition of the same deck: a start gate with voice cards, pre-rendered neural voices with word timings, captions that highlight each spoken word, a timeline scrubber with scene markers, speed, chapters and a share link to the exact moment.

name: Animated AI narrator
description: A stylized, clearly badged AI bust that blinks, breathes and lip syncs from the audio level.
prompt_snippet: In the film edition, show a stylized animated narrator in the camera box, clearly badged AI, that blinks, breathes and lip syncs from the live audio level, and never impersonates the presenter.

name: Deep links to scene and step
description: #scene/step written on every move; works with voice and speed parameters in the film.
prompt_snippet: Write #scene/step to the URL on every move and restore it on load, so any link opens the exact scene and click.
